title: Recursive network and proxy dependencies
summary: A running container can have an unreachable service through namespace DNS, network attachment, published-port routing, firewall or upstream failure. Exposure metadata describes intent, while a route probe measures operation.
checks: Declare DNS, TCP/TLS and functional HTTP checks from the affected vantage in order.
Separate container-local health from the published application path and downstream database role/read contract.
limitations: This module does not inspect network policy or assert reachability from state alone.
